reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text:
I was looking for a moisturizer that could give my skin enough hydration without feeling heavy, greasy or suffocating, and this gel cream has been a great choice. My skin is sensitive and acne-prone, with visible pores and uneven texture, so I’m quite picky with moisturizers.
The texture is exactly what I like: light, fresh and easy to spread. It feels very comfortable on the skin and gives hydration without leaving my face covered in a thick layer. I also love how well it works with the rest of my skincare routine.
For someone like me who dislikes rich, heavy creams, this is such a pleasant product to use. I’ve really enjoyed it and would definitely consider buying it again.
reviews.zh:
我一直想搵一款保濕品，可以俾到皮膚足夠水分，但又唔會笠、唔會油笠、唔會焗住塊面，呢款 gel cream 真係揀啱咗。我皮膚敏感加容易爆瘡，有明顯毛孔同膚質唔均，所以對保濕品好揀擇。
質地完全啱我心水：清爽、輕盈、易推開。上皮膚好舒服，做到保濕之餘又唔會搽到塊面厚厚一層。我亦好鍾意佢同我其他護膚程序夾得好好。
對我呢種唔鍾意豐厚重型乳霜嘅人嚟講，呢款真係用得好舒服。我真係好鍾意，絕對會考慮再回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text: Потрясающий легкий гель-крем! Он идеально сужает поры, мгновенно освежает кожу и устраняет жирный блеск, оставляя лицо матовым и гладким. Текстура невесомая, впитывается за секунды и отлично увлажняет благодаря центелле. Настоящее спасение для комбинированной и жирной кожи!
reviews.zh: 超讚嘅清爽 gel cream！可以完美收細毛孔，瞬間令皮膚變得清爽，消除油光，令塊面保持霧面又滑溜。質地零負擔，幾秒就吸收晒，而且有積雪草保濕真係好正。簡直係混合性同油性肌嘅救星！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text: I have extremely oily skin, this moisturiser is amazing for me. It’s super light and doesn’t make my skin feel oily or too moisturised. Great, highly recommended!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚超級油，呢款保濕品對我嚟講真係一流。質地超輕盈，唔會令皮膚感到油笠或者過度保濕。好正，勁推薦！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text: Its been nearly a month since Ive used this and each time i use this before bed, i wake up with the glassy glow. This is perfect. Im halfway through this cream bottle! Smooth and light, perfect for the night time
reviews.zh: 用咗差唔多一個月，每晚瞓覺前搽完，第二朝醒嚟塊面都係玻璃光。完美。我已經用咗半支！滑順又輕盈，夜晚用一流

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text: The Skin 1024 Mineral Moisturizer is a true skin-saver. Its texture is lightweight yet nourishing, absorbing quickly without leaving any greasy film. I love how it hydrates deeply while still feeling breathable and comfortable on the skin. The mineral-rich formula soothes and balances, making it perfect for daily use, especially for sensitive or combination skin. It leaves my skin soft, refreshed, and with a healthy glow throughout the day. Unlike heavier creams, it layers beautifully under sunscreen or makeup. Overall, it’s a gentle but effective moisturizer that delivers lasting hydration and strengthens the skin barrier. Highly recommended.
reviews.zh: The Skin 1024 Mineral Moisturizer 真係皮膚救星。質地輕盈但有營養，吸收得好快，唔會留低任何油笠薄膜。我好鍾意佢深層保濕之餘，皮膚感覺依然透氣舒服。富含礦物嘅配方有舒緩同平衡效果，適合日日用，特別適合敏感肌或者混合性。用完皮膚變得柔軟清爽，全日都保持健康光澤。比起厚身乳霜，佢可以好好咁疊喺防曬或者妝前底下用。整體嚟講係一款溫和但有效嘅保濕品，帶嚟持久保濕同時強化皮膚屏障。高度推薦。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text: I really have visible pores and this helped so much. For my type of skin, I don’t expect the pores to be just gone all the way right away but it did help in a way that it’s not a worry to me anymore.
reviews.zh: 我本身毛孔真係好明顯，呢款幫咗我好多。以我呢種膚質，我本來就唔期望毛孔即時完全消失，但佢真係幫到一個程度，令我唔再為毛孔而煩惱。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing light gel cream 75ml
reviews.text: I use this every night to lock-in moisture. I have combination skin, and I don’t like using cream or heavy moisturiser since I’ve discovered it breaks me out. This moisturiser is also fungal acne safe (for those girlies with fungal acne). This is highly recommended.
reviews.zh: 我每晚都用佢嚟鎖住水分。我係混合性肌，自從發現用乳霜或者重型保濕品會爆瘡之後就唔敢再用。呢款保濕品都係 fungal acne safe（畀有真菌暗瘡嘅姊妹仔）。勁推薦。
